An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<a href="https://example.com/outer"><table><tr><td><a href="https://example.com/inner">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
